quest.title: Three to Get Ready, and Here We Go
quest.description: With the finals looming, you and Paimon go to Wanmin Restaurant to look for Xiangling...
quest.rewards_formatted: Primogem x60, Hero's Wit x3, Mora x30000

chapter.title: Three to Get Ready, and Here We Go

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey Xiangling, we're here!

dialogues.speaker: Xiangling
dialogues.text: Traveler, Paimon! Did you hear the news? I made it through the selections for Masterful Chefs!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Really!? Woohoo, that's great!

choices.text: I knew you could do it.

response.speaker: Xiangling
response.text: Hee-hee, it was a total breeze, I wasn't even trying... Uh, but a true champion never rests on their laurels! I'm still gonna need your help to prepare for the competition.

response.speaker: Xiangling
response.text: I made a few new test dishes and I was hoping everyone could try them and give some feedback. Traveler, you wanna be the first?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: What a shame, we just ate.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Uh... oh, yeah, we did! And anyway, we get to eat your food all the time, so we're biased. You should find some other people this time, just to play it safe.

response.speaker: Xiangling
response.text: Good idea! Okay lemme think, mmm... Ah, let's get Beidou to try it first.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Beidou! Yup, you can definitely trust her opinion! Let's go find her.

response.speaker: Xiangling
response.text: Right now, she should be down at the docks. Lemme box up this food real quick, then we can head on down.

choices.text: You're in a league of your own, Xiangling.

talks.objective: Go to the wharf to look for Beidou

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Beidou ahoy! Hey look, who's she with?

dialogues.speaker: Xiangling
dialogues.text: Hi Beidou, hi Xinyan. Are we interrupting anything?

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: Xiangling? The woman of the hour, we were just talking about you.

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: Beidou was sayin' you and I should get ourselves on board some time. Says the whole crew's been asking for us, haha!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Seems like you three go way back.

dialogues.speaker: Xiangling
dialogues.text: Oh, we really do! Beidou and Xinyan are two of my oldest customers, and I've helped out in the kitchen on board Beidou's ship in the past. Recently, Xinyan's been planning to do a show aboard, too!

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: That's the plan, good music's meant for sharing! You guys should check it out sometime!

dialogues.speaker: Xiangling
dialogues.text: Will do! But I came here today because I made it into the Masterful Chefs finals, and I was just trying out some new dishes to bring to the competition. Can you have a little taste and gimme some feedback?

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: Sure, beats drinking on an empty stomach.

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: 'Bout time, I'm starvin' over here! Let's see what you got.

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: Aw man! This Chicken Foo Yung is tasting awesome!

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: This food is too good for me to be soaking up the alcohol with, haha.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: These three seem to have a great time with each other.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Those are the kinds of friends you want in life.

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: Only thing is, you've got three dishes here, Chicken Foo Yung, Come and Get It, and Crystal Shrimp, and they all taste kinda refreshing.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uh... is refreshing really a flavor?

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: When you spend all your time at sea, you don't have a lot of choice when it comes to food. Especially on the longer voyages, where you've gotta stretch your rations out as far as you can.

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: The first thing you wanna do when you get back on dry land is dig into a nice hot meal that's swimming in oil and has a ton of flavor.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That's the exact opposite of Ningguang's tastes!

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: Sure is! Beidou's tastes are pretty similar to mine and Xiangling's.

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: Ugh, Ningguang... I am sick of hearing that name.

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: Our tastes couldn't be more different. You'll never find us eating the same bowl of food.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: But last time when you were chatting with her, Paimon thought you two seemed to get along just fine.

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: We're evenly matched. Guess that makes us equals. But I'm sorry, limp cabbage leaves are never gonna do it for me.

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: I hear ya, I hear ya! Steamed Cabbage in Broth might be upper class and look fancy and all, but man, is it boring! It's never gonna give you that flavor explosion you get with some of the other dishes out there.

dialogues.speaker: Xiangling
dialogues.text: So, Xinyan, are these dishes too mild for you, too?

dialogues.speaker: Xiangling
dialogues.text: Not so much mild... I just think you maybe missed a beat somewhere.

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: Exactly. This is some fine cooking, no question about that. But if this is for a competition, it needs more oomph.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Beat? Oomph? Are we sure these terms apply to cooking?

dialogues.speaker: Xiangling
dialogues.text: Beat... and oomph...

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: Beat, yeah. You know what a beat is. I only know music though, I'm nowhere near your level when it comes to cooking. So don't mind me if it doesn't make much sense!

dialogues.speaker: Xiangling
dialogues.text: No, no, you're both completely right. Beat and oomph! That's what I need!

dialogues.speaker: Xiangling
dialogues.text: I actually thought as much while I was cooking them, even though this was a brand-new combination, it still felt like I was missing that one thing that'll seal the deal... y'know, really push it over the finish line!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Seems like she's found her muse. Does that mean... music theory is compatible with cooking?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Every bit as compatible as we are.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey! ...Paimon didn't quite get the implication, but Paimon can tell when you're being a meanie!

dialogues.speaker: Xiangling
dialogues.text: Okay, I think I know what I need to do.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Great! So this went really well!

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: Don't hold back, just get out there and do your thing! You're a pro, Xiangling, and you've totally got this. Hands down, best chef in Liyue Harbor! Ain't that right, Beidou?

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: Well, I think so, anyway. More than any other chef. And there ain't a whole lot of people that I'd be willing to say that about.

dialogues.speaker: Xiangling
dialogues.text: Hee-hee, I'll do my best! Thanks, everyone!

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: Alright, we'll leave you to it. I'm gonna take Xinyan on board for a while.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Xiangling, they both had pretty strong tastes. You sure that won't be a problem? Shouldn't we get a second opinion from someone with milder tastes?

dialogues.speaker: Xiangling
dialogues.text: That's a good point. Beidou likes her greasy stir-fries, and Xinyan can really handle her spice... Yeah, we should get another opinion.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Now, who do we know whose tastes are on the mild side? Traveler, any suggestions?

choices.text: A certain person comes to mind again...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Who, who, who?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: You know, Almond Tofu...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh, right! Makes sense. So, back to Wangshu Inn?

response.speaker: Xiangling
response.text: Who? Who is it?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Someone you just missed last time we were there!

choices.text: We don't need to go to Wangshu Inn.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh! Paimon remembers! He said that we just need to speak his name, and poof, he'll show up.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Um... will he definitely hear us saying his name though? Maybe we should find somewhere quieter.

choices.text: We can do it right here.
Yep, I've thought of someone with mild tastes.

talks.objective: Go to a more peaceful location

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Okay, let's take turns shouting his name!

dialogues.speaker: Xiangling
dialogues.text: Huh? Do I need to do this, too?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon's going first! *clears throat*

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Xiaaaao!!!

dialogues.speaker: Xiangling
dialogues.text: Um, nothing's happening...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Lemme try again. Xiaaaao!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That's weird... Does he not wanna hang out with us?

dialogues.speaker: Xiangling
dialogues.text: Wait, so let me get this straight. Some guy with special powers promised you both that you just need to shout his name, and he'll show up?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Um, well... not "both," actually. Just one of us...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: He promised it to me.

dialogues.speaker: Xiangling
dialogues.text: Oh, right. Well, you should be the one to try it then. Paimon clearly just doesn't want to feel left out.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wah... Okay then...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Xiao, you there?
You called?

dialogues.speaker: Xiangling
dialogues.text: Whoa!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: He actually came!

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: You spoke my name, did you not?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I didn't think that would actually work...

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: When I make you a promise, I will honor it.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Blink of an eye, and poof, he's there! That's how you know he's an adeptus...

dialogues.speaker: Xiangling
dialogues.text: An adeptus!? Uhh... Xiao, was it? Hi there, it was me who asked the Traveler to call you here. My name's Xiangling. I'm a chef.

dialogues.speaker: Xiangling
dialogues.text: I've made it into the finals of this year's Masterful Chefs, and I'm testing some dishes out in preparation. I'm trying to get feedback from customers with all different tastes.

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: Customers... and that includes me?

dialogues.speaker: Xiangling
dialogues.text: Uh-huh! The Traveler says you prefer mild food — just the kind of person I'm looking for. If you don't mind, I'd like you to try the dishes I've made and tell me your thoughts.

response.speaker: Xiao
response.text: Since it's you... I will do it.

response.speaker: Xiangling
response.text: Yay!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Um, how is it? Are you sure you can eat it? Don't force yourself!

response.speaker: Xiao
response.text: ...Tastes pretty good.

response.speaker: Xiangling
response.text: Huh? R—Really?

response.speaker: Xiangling
response.text: I can't believe it, an adeptus said he likes my cooking... If my dad was here, he'd be crying tears of joy!

response.speaker: Xiao
response.text: You excel in the culinary arts. I'm reminded of another chef I know.

response.speaker: Xiao
response.text: That chef cooks dishes with soul, as do you. Both of you are masters of your craft.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Who do you think he means? Smiley Yanxiao?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: It has to be Yanxiao!

response.speaker: Xiao
response.text: If I had to find fault with something... the two sides are a little strong for my taste. Some minor adjustments would take this dish from excellence to perfection.

response.speaker: Xiao
response.text: Just my own opinion... do not fixate on it. Take it or leave it as you see fit.

response.speaker: Xiangling
response.text: Alright, go easy on the sides... okay, I got it.

response.speaker: Xiangling
response.text: Thank you, adeptus friend! It was really great to meet you!

response.speaker: Xiao
response.text: I'll be leaving now.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Thank you.

response.speaker: Xiao
response.text: See you next time.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon still can't believe he actually came!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: So what would happen if we called his name again now? Do you think he'd come back right away?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Paimon, we're not doing that.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Only kinda, maybe, not really, joking, geez...

response.speaker: Xiangling
response.text: Good news! After two rounds of taste-testing, I've had an idea on what to do next!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Great! Lucky we picked the right people to talk to.

response.speaker: Xiangling
response.text: I'd better head back and try this out a few times while it's fresh in my mind. Thanks for your help!

response.speaker: Xiangling
response.text: Oh, and the final is in Yujing Terrace. You'd better come and watch!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Will do. Good luck!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: You'll do great!

response.speaker: Xiangling
response.text: Hee-hee, you bet!

talks.objective: Go to Wanmin Restaurant to see how Xiangling is doing

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Seems like she's in the zone... talking away to herself...

dialogues.speaker: Xiangling
dialogues.text: Hmm, Jueyun Chili Chicken, Triple-Layered Consommé, Crystal Shrimp...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Are those the dishes she's gonna cook? Mmmm... Okay, now Paimon's hungry. One of each please! Get cooking, {NICKNAME}!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Alright, sure...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wait, can you actually cook all of those? Or is Paimon just assuming that because we eat them all the time? Hehe...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: How about we see if they sell recipes around here?

talks.objective: Purchase and learn recipes for Paimon's favorite dishes

dialogues.speaker: Ningguang
dialogues.text: We have two extraordinary talents this year. I'm interested to see their choice of dishes.

talks.objective: Wait for the competition to start the next day (10:00 – 14:00)
Go to the area where the match will take place

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: Welcome, everyone, to the Masterful Chefs final. At the appointment of the organizing committee, I am your host and officiator, Yanfei!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey, Yanfei's here too!

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: This event is brought to you by the Liyue Qixing in collaboration with a number of participating enterprises. The competition is divided into the selections phase and the finals.

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: We saw many contestants from all over Liyue in the selections process, and all of them were outstanding chefs in their own right. Of those, the two strongest participants were put through to today's finals.

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: In just a few short moments, the finals will take place right here, before your very eyes!

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: As the officiator, it is my honor and privilege to represent the organizing committee and indeed the people of Liyue in overseeing today's proceedings.

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: Next, please allow me to introduce the judges. There will be a select panel and an audience panel. The three members of the select panel are:

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: The Tianquan, Lady Ningguang!

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: The Yuheng, Lady Keqing!

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: And last but not least, gourmet connoisseur, Uncle Tian!

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: In addition to these three, 10 judges will be chosen from among the audience to sample our contestants' dishes and cast their vote.

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: That makes a total of 13 judges with 13 votes between them. Each judge will vote for their preferred finalist, and the one who receives the most votes will be today's winner!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Eee, it's all so exciting!

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: And now, please join me in welcoming our two contestants into the arena! Come on out!

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: To my left, a competition favorite down from Dihua. Life's harsh when you live on a marsh, but this kitchen ace will put a smile on your face — please welcome, Smiley Yanxiao!

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: Uh... Hi everyone...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa, Yanxiao made it into the finals too! But what's up with him? He seems really nervous...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: To be fair, it's a big event.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yanxiaaaao! Chin up, shoulders back! Everyone from the inn is super proud of you!

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: Huh? O—Oh, heh...

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: And to my right, a stalwart of the Liyue Harbor culinary scene, a little feisty with a whole lot of spicy — give it up for Xiangling!

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: ...Uh, and her mysterious assistant, who-knows-who!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon knows, it's Guoba!

dialogues.speaker: Xiangling
dialogues.text: Hey everybody! I'll do my best!

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: Contestants, please repeat after me: As a finalist in Masterful Chefs, I solemnly swear to commit myself fully, compete fairly, and abide by all competition procedures.

dialogues.speaker: Xiangling
dialogues.text: As a finalist in Masterful Chefs, I solemnly swear to commit myself fully, compete fairly, and abide by all competition procedures.

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: Uh... As a finalist in Masterful Chefs, I, um, solemnly swear to commit myself fully, compete fairly, and abide by all competition procedures.

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: And I, for my part, promise to uphold the principles of fairness, impartiality, and transparency in my officiation of the proceedings.

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: Now, I will hand things over to the select panel judge, Ningguang, for the announcement of today's theme!

dialogues.speaker: Ningguang
dialogues.text: Thank you all for being here today at the Masterful Chefs finals. I am the Tianquan, Ningguang.

dialogues.speaker: Ningguang
dialogues.text: The organizers have chosen the theme for today's event, and that theme is: "Of Earth and Water Born."

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: "Of Earth and Water Born"... Just like "Feast of the Bounteous Land," it really captures the spirit of this year's Moonchase Festival.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It's like surf and turf, but the deep and meaningful version.

dialogues.speaker: Ningguang
dialogues.text: The rules are simple — the one who receives the most votes, wins. Tailor your dishes to the judges' preferences or win over the audience with your originality. The choice is yours.

dialogues.speaker: Ningguang
dialogues.text: Well then. I look forward to both of your contributions.

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: Contestants will have one hour of cooking time available, and may only use ingredients provided by the organizers in their dishes. I trust this is no problem.

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: Okay! Without further ado, let the cooking commence! Begin!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Time to pull out all the stops! Show everyone why you're the best!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Woop woop, go, Xiangling!

dialogues.speaker: Xiangling
dialogues.text: Traveler, Paimon!

dialogues.speaker: Xiangling
dialogues.text: Hee-hee... Thanks for coming to support me! Don't you worry, I'm gonna make this the best-tasting dish I ever cooked!

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: Whoa, whoa, what's this? Hold up, things are taking an unexpected turn on the Masterful Chefs stage!

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: Xiangling's mysterious assistant appears to be aiding her opponent! Judges — are we going to allow this?

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: We knew in advance that Xiangling would be accompanied by a mysterious assistant, and the judges agreed that the two could be classed as one individual for the purposes of the competition. But what do we say to this!?

dialogues.speaker: Ningguang
dialogues.text: I take no issue with it. In any case, the assistant hasn't done much in the way of assisting.

dialogues.speaker: Uncle Tian
dialogues.text: Haha... no competition would be complete without a little drama. All part of being young. I won't be the old fogey that ruins it for them.

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: Ahem... please allow me to explain to our host.

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: Prior to the competition, the judges reviewed both contestants, and we can comfortably confirm that neither side is participating in a way that contravenes the competition rules.

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: Xiangling is a highly accomplished chef, and her "assistant" is more like family to her.

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: Xiangling prepares all of her own dishes herself. All that her assistant will do is occasionally provide a fire source. Given Xiangling's level of culinary skill, the difference between her using firewood or her assistant is a trivial one.

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: I appreciate everyone's concerns. The presence of a mysterious assistant performing strange dance moves to cheerlead for Xiangling is a little unexpected.

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: But the mysterious assistant has now started cheerleading for Smiley Yanxiao too, demonstrating total impartiality. By encouraging both Xiangling and her opponent, they have proven to be a fair supporter.

dialogues.speaker: Xiangling
dialogues.text: That's right! Guoba's not really outside help — Guoba just likes to watch people cook! I'm sure the only reason they went over there is to try and help Yanxiao feel less nervous.

dialogues.speaker: Xiangling
dialogues.text: I give you all my word, Guoba will not interfere with the competition. And I would also say that it's a loss to the competition if Yanxiao isn't at the top of his form!

dialogues.speaker: Xiangling
dialogues.text: I say that as someone who's eaten Yanxiao's cooking at Wangshu Inn before. He's an excellent chef, and I want this to be a competition between the best we both have to bring.

dialogues.speaker: Ningguang
dialogues.text: I see... most amusing. Uncle Tian, what's your opinion?

dialogues.speaker: Uncle Tian
dialogues.text: I have no objections. It's an honor and a privilege to see two contestants so dedicated to having a fair and square contest.

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: The judges and the officiator accept this explanation! Let the competition continue!

dialogues.speaker: Xiangling
dialogues.text: Yanxiao, are you alright?

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: I don't know what's wrong with me, I've never been so nervous in my life! ...Ugh, look, my hands won't stop shaking...

dialogues.speaker: Xiangling
dialogues.text: Take it easy! I've been there before, I can help! Trying say a tongue-twister to yourself in your head, or... think of some happy memories about your dad!

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: Why my dad? That's a bit specific...

dialogues.speaker: Xiangling
dialogues.text: 'Cause that's what I do.

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: Uh... I guess I'll think of my mom, then. A—Anyway, you should carry on! I'll be fine. Don't hold up your own dishes on my account.

dialogues.speaker: Xiangling
dialogues.text: Nothing's being held up. I'm finished already.

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: Huh!? Right, then I need to focus up and win this thing!

dialogues.speaker: Xiangling
dialogues.text: There you go, that's the attitude we want! You're a very capable chef, Yanxiao. So come on, show everyone what you're made of — just like you showed us last time at Wangshu Inn!

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: Yes... you're right, I can do this. I can do this!

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: Thank you, Xiangling, and thanks to your, um... well, thanks. Time for me to get cooking!

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: Time's up!

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: Both contestants have now finished cooking. I would like to invite them to present their dishes to the judges for evaluation.

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: We will proceed in the order that the contestants finished. Xiangling — please describe your dish!

dialogues.speaker: Xiangling
dialogues.text: My dish is:

dialogues.speaker: Xiangling
dialogues.text: Jueyun Chili Chicken with sides of Triple-Layered Consommé and Crystal Shrimp.

dialogues.speaker: Xiangling
dialogues.text: The theme is "Of Earth and Water Born," which includes land and sea. In other words, land animals, fowl, and seafood are all potential ingredients.

dialogues.speaker: Xiangling
dialogues.text: My main dish, Jueyun Chili Chicken, is a combination of Fowl and chilis. Jueyun Chilis capture the essence of the mountains where they grow, and Fowl is a gift from the heavens.

dialogues.speaker: Xiangling
dialogues.text: Triple-Layered Consommé also uses Fowl, and its other ingredients are Ham and Bamboo Shoots. These are also flavors from the mountains, but they complement and contrast with the chicken dish — fresh instead of spicy, cold instead of hot.

dialogues.speaker: Xiangling
dialogues.text: The Crystal Shrimp is made from a combination of Rice, Shrimp Meat, and Carrot. A thin, translucent skin wraps diced Carrot and a whole shrimp. Fresh, crispy, and tender.

dialogues.speaker: Xiangling
dialogues.text: Shrimps are a gift from the ocean. Tightly wrapping them in a skin made from rice makes this dish a blend of land and sea, fresh with a hint of sweetness. It's the perfect note to end this course on.

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: A strong delivery there from Xiangling. Let's see what our next contestant, Yanxiao, has to say!

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: My dish is...

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: Adeptus' Temptation with a Mint Salad and Golden Shrimp Balls.

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: As Xiangling says, earth and water means land and sea. So birds, land animals, and seafood were also the ingredients I incorporated.

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: Adeptus' Temptation is a much-loved dish in Liyue, and as chef of Wangshu Inn, I've always been proud to offer this as the signature specialty dish of our menu.

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: It's a complex dish with very particular ingredients: smoked Ham, Crab, fresh Shrimp Meat, and Matsutake. I chose this as my main dish, as a sign of respect toward my profession and to this competition.

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: The Mint Salad is my first side. Cool and tender with a subtle sweetness, it's a perfect answer to the rich and strong flavors of the Adeptus' Temptation.

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: Golden Shrimp Balls is a time-honored classic loved by everyone. A hearty and wholesome broth followed up with a shrimp ball, hehe... Pure bliss!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Mmmm~! Paimon can smell it from all the way over here! It's driving Paimon crazy...

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: Judges, please sample the dishes!

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: Very impressive. Both contestants' dishes are well-considered, expertly made, and truly delicious. I'm gonna have another Golden Shrimp Ba— um, I mean, I shall have to sample both contestants' dishes once more before I can reach a verdict.

dialogues.speaker: Uncle Tian
dialogues.text: Now, Xiangling has taken an interesting approach here: She's chosen a cold dish as her main. I have to say, that's a bold move.

dialogues.speaker: Uncle Tian
dialogues.text: It's also a unique take on Jueyun Chili Chicken. Although the dish as a whole is served cold, the chili peppers have been stir-fried and so they're still just a little warm on the inside. You get a nice crunch as you bite in, then you get the spiciness and warmth all coming in together, and then just a hint of that wonderful pepperiness to top it all off... It's quite simply extraordinary!

dialogues.speaker: Ningguang
dialogues.text: This Adeptus' Temptation is quite exceptional. The Triple-Layered Consommé is also a very superlative contribution — excellent flavor, well-balanced between sweet and savory. Yes... the standard is very high.

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: Judges of the select panel, I will now ask you to consider your votes carefully before writing them down and handing them to me!

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: Also, the organizing committee has selected today's audience judges, and they are now evaluating the dishes. Everyone who's been lucky enough to sample today's dishes, please consider and cast your vote independently.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ugh, how are we not involved in this!? Why didn't they pick us to be judges?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon has buckets of passion and oodles of expertise when it comes to food — if they don't want Paimon, it's their loss! Ohh...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Calm down, Paimon. I'll cook the same dishes for you later.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yippy! For all the chefs there are in the world, and for all the amazing dishes they can cook, the fact remains that you're the one who treats Paimon best!

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: Thank you all for waiting! All votes have been received and counted, and the results have been returned to Ningguang.

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: I now invite Ningguang to take the floor and announce the results of the Masterful Chefs finals!

dialogues.speaker: Ningguang
dialogues.text: It is my pleasure to announce that the winner of the Masterful Chefs finals is:

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: Ah...

dialogues.speaker: Xiangling
dialogues.text: Ooh...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ahhhh...

dialogues.speaker: Ningguang
dialogues.text: By a mere one-vote margin, Xiangling.

dialogues.speaker: Xiangling
dialogues.text: Wow!!!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whaaaat!? How was it so close!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Yanxiao is a great chef too.

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: There it is... *sigh* I knew it.

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: It was a close contest, but we have a winner! Liyue Harbor's Xiangling has beaten Dihua Marsh's Yanxiao by just one vote!

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: There can only be one winner, but the fact that this was so close shows just how much both of these outstanding chefs managed to impress our judges. Thank you both for your stellar contributions here today!

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: A big thank you to all the audience for being here today, especially those who have come from far and wide. As officiator, I declare the result of this competition to be fair and valid, thus bringing the Masterful Chefs finals to a close!

dialogues.speaker: Ningguang
dialogues.text: Thank you all for coming. Until next time.

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: Please exit the venue in an orderly fashion and remember to take all of your personal belongings with you.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: C'mon, let's go over and take a look!

talks.objective: Talk to Xiangling and Smiley Yanxiao

dialogues.speaker: Xiangling
dialogues.text: Looks like I won this time, Yanxiao. But I'd still like to try your dishes, if that's okay?

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: Sure, I'll have a try of yours too.

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: Whew... truly exquisite. No doubt in my mind why you're the winner here.

dialogues.speaker: Xiangling
dialogues.text: Mmm... This Adeptus' Temptation is really good! It's so fresh I'm almost moved to tears...

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: Haha, well, just goes to show that you have a taste for the finer things in life.

dialogues.speaker: Xiangling
dialogues.text: No, no, you've got me all wrong! We're just a small neighborhood restaurant too, so I totally understand... Food is life, and customers are at the heart of all food culture. So humble home cooking is not to be looked down upon!

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: Is that right? Huh, I'd heard you'd gotten famous for your experimental approach to cooking and were all about fancy and exclusive foods. Never realized you'd done your time in a small kitchen too. Well, there you have it. All the greats come from the smaller places.

dialogues.speaker: Xiangling
dialogues.text: Same goes for you! You can't work in an inn kitchen unless you know how to consistently please customers. It's no wonder your food is so top-notch.

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: You're the kind of competition I'm glad to have. Let's stay in touch, maybe we can find some time in the future to trade tips.

dialogues.speaker: Xiangling
dialogues.text: You got it! And next time we meet as competitors, let's both be even better than we are now!

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: Alright, deal!

dialogues.speaker: Xiangling
dialogues.text: Traveler, Paimon! Thanks for coming. Did you get to try the food?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Don't even go there! Paimon's still peeved!

dialogues.speaker: Xiangling
dialogues.text: Hahaha, I can't believe it — you didn't get picked? Well, never mind, don't get mad — I'll make some more for you when we get back.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You will? Woohoo, great!

dialogues.speaker: Xiangling
dialogues.text: Oh, uh, the organizers said that Yanxiao and I need to go register our delivery addresses. Apparently they're gonna deliver an exclusive ingredients package and the prize money at a later date. So I need to get moving!

dialogues.speaker: Xiangling
dialogues.text: I'll come find you guys after!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Aw, Xiangling seems really happy. Good for her.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Looks like Keqing and Ningguang left already. As the organizers, they must've gone to wrap up some last-minute things. Let's go ask them for an update about the statue!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Keqing! There you are!

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: Oh. You found me.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? Is everything okay?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (Something is weighing on Keqing's mind.)

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: Traveler. I have found myself in something of a predicament.

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: In the competition, I voted for Smiley Yanxiao.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So, you're frustrated because you can't go back and vote for Xiangling instead?

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: No, that's not it. As a judge, I had a duty to remain objective. I made my decision after thinking about it very carefully, and my conscience is clear.

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: Xiangling is my friend. So by rights, I should be honest with her about this.

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: But as you know, I voted based purely on my personal opinion. As a contestant, Xiangling may not be able to appreciate this. And I do not know how to deal with people of her temperament... *sigh* I just don't know how to break it to her.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ah, it's no big deal, just say it however comes naturally. Xiangling of all people isn't bothered about that kind of stuff. And anyway, she still won in the end!

dialogues.speaker: Xiangling
dialogues.text: Oh hey, here you are! I've been looking for you for ages!

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: Xiangling... There's something I need to tell you.

dialogues.speaker: Xiangling
dialogues.text: Hmm? Wh—What is it?

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: My grandfather always said to me, "In contests of food, always follow your heart." Which is to say that in gastronomical disputes or indeed competitions, one must cast their vote for the party that they agree with. This decision must be based on one's honest thoughts, not influenced by any external factors.

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: Of course, that was just my grandfather's opinion. But I have to say, I am inclined to think he had a point...

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: So... despite the fact that I am your friend, I cast my vote for Smiley Yanxiao's Adeptus' Temptation...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I think you mean the Golden Shrimp Balls.

dialogues.speaker: Xiangling
dialogues.text: Heh...

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: W—Well... maybe it was! I like Golden Shrimp Balls, is that a problem!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (Shutting up...)

dialogues.speaker: Xiangling
dialogues.text: You were acting so serious that I honestly thought something was up! It's fine, doesn't bother me one bit.

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: Huh?

dialogues.speaker: Xiangling
dialogues.text: You voted for who you wanted to. That's totally okay — in fact, that's exactly how it should be. Otherwise, how could it be a fair competition?

dialogues.speaker: Xiangling
dialogues.text: So... you made a point of telling me, is that because you were worried that it made you a bad friend?

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: Ahem, ahem! I... don't be absurd.

dialogues.speaker: Xiangling
dialogues.text: *sigh* Didn't I say already? I love this about you — you're just so conscientious about everything. Half-baked feedback just isn't meaningful to me at this stage.

dialogues.speaker: Xiangling
dialogues.text: Seeking reassurance is what novices do, and it's been a long time since I was a novice. The way forward from today will only get more challenging, as will the dishes I'll need to cook. Honestly, I'll need friends like you along the way.

dialogues.speaker: Xiangling
dialogues.text: You have a strong sense of responsibility, Keqing. But you know, not everything is always about responsibility. Yes, you're a Qixing, but you're also you — Keqing. When you're with friends, you don't need to think about everything so thoroughly.

dialogues.speaker: Xiangling
dialogues.text: You know that's what Ningguang's like, right? Beidou's always telling me about how well she gets along with Ningguang. They even play chess on board her ship sometimes.

dialogues.speaker: Xiangling
dialogues.text: So you see, Ningguang's kinda bold in that she doesn't let her identity and reputation get in the way of her ability to have a good time. You could take a leaf out of her book. Outside of work, it's time to let go and relax.

choices.text: Xiangling is right on the money.

response.speaker: Keqing
response.text: Traveler... Xiangling, I...

response.speaker: Keqing
response.text: A—Anyway, what are we standing around here for? Let's go and check on the status of the Stove God statue!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh yeah, Paimon had nearly forgotten about that! Let's go see!

choices.text: You don't need to be so strict with yourself.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: How strange, it hasn't changed one bit...

dialogues.speaker: Xiangling
dialogues.text: This doesn't make any sense... we cooked our hearts out!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Does this mean... the competition wasn't enough to awaken the statue?

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: Oh well... I suppose it was simply not meant to be.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: There's still time. Don't lose hope.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yeah. We've waited this long already, there's no harm in waiting a little longer.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Right, Xiangling?

dialogues.speaker: Xiangling
dialogues.text: Yep! There's still time, let's be patient. We'll all see this through together.

dialogues.speaker: Xiangling
dialogues.text: On another note, I have some good news for you, Keqing! Things are looking optimistic for that recipe you gave me.

dialogues.speaker: Xiangling
dialogues.text: Master came by before the competition and filled in the parts that were missing. So now, I'll be able to cook it.

dialogues.speaker: Xiangling
dialogues.text: In fact, I'll go find somewhere to make it right now. Wait here!

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: Xiangling...

dialogues.speaker: Xiangling
dialogues.text: Oh, uh, and Traveler, could you come with me?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? You only just beat Smiley Yanxiao. You think you're up for challenging us already?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Alright, time for me to get real.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'm something of a kitchen god myself.

dialogues.speaker: Xiangling
dialogues.text: Obviously not what I meant!

dialogues.speaker: Xiangling
dialogues.text: You collect recipes, don't you? I thought you'd probably be needing this dish during your travels, so I figured I'd share it with you.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, right. Paimon knew that. Sheesh, we totally misread that situation...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Who am I kidding, Xiangling's the real kitchen queen.

dialogues.speaker: Xiangling
dialogues.text: Huh? Geez, careful eating your words so fast, you'll give yourself heartburn!

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: Pfft... hehe.

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: ...What are you staring at me for? Go on, go get on with your cooking.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We're back!

dialogues.speaker: Xiangling
dialogues.text: The Traveler and I made one each. Here, have a taste while it's still warm.

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: Thank you. Don't mind if I do.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What is it? What does that face mean?

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: (This flavor... I've tasted it before!)

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Uh... Keqing?

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: ...Apologies.

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: Xiangling, Traveler, thank you both. This is everything I had hoped it would be.

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: It tastes wonderful, and... quite amazingly, somehow it took me right back to my childhood, when my grandfather was still around.

dialogues.speaker: Xiangling
dialogues.text: Really? That's awesome!

dialogues.speaker: Xiangling
dialogues.text: I didn't have a chance to fully explain before. In fact, when Master had filled in the missing parts of the recipe for me, I realized that I already knew how to make this dish.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You already knew? You mean, you were able to make this without ever seeing the recipe?

dialogues.speaker: Xiangling
dialogues.text: Uh-huh. My dad taught me how to make it.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wait, but isn't this dish from Keqing's grandpa's notes, though?

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: About that... I do not believe that this recipe was my grandfather's creation.

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: My grandfather was a well-known real estate tycoon in Liyue, and also a scholar. He was an avid collector of old books and was quite knowledgeable on many of Liyue's customs and traditions that are no longer practiced.

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: As a child, I used to spend a lot of time with him in his study. We'd read the classics together, then debate how much of it was actually genuine, and whether Rex Lapis was real or not...

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: He used to say, "Books are just a bridge that bring us a little closer to history. It's up to those of us in later generations to ask these questions, search for the answers, and decide what they mean."

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: Since then, my grandfather has passed on, and I've grown up to become a Qixing. My views on Rex Lapis have changed in this time, too, from myth to reality.

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: For me, the name Rex Lapis is inextricably wound up with memories of my grandfather. Whenever I see his name written down, it always reminds me of sitting in my grandfather's study... seeing all of his notes.

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: As I said earlier, this recipe came from those same notes. It's an ancient dish that he was trying to restore to its original form, but unfortunately, without the full recipe, he never quite succeeded.

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: Still, each time he tried cooking it, he'd always get me to have a taste while it was still warm... ah, the memories. This really is the taste of my childhood.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ancient dish? Are cornbread buns really that old?

dialogues.speaker: Xiangling
dialogues.text: Well, at least in my family it is. My dad learned how to make it from his dad, and supposedly, it's been passed down that way for generations.

dialogues.speaker: Xiangling
dialogues.text: We call them Chili-Mince Cornbread Buns! They're a traditional folk-food snack, easy to pack up and take with you on the road, so they're the perfect thing to eat on the go.

dialogues.speaker: Xiangling
dialogues.text: Haha, seeing Guoba just reminded me of something. I actually made this dish on the day that I first met Guoba!

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: How did you first meet?

dialogues.speaker: Xiangling
dialogues.text: It was in a cave in the mountains! I ducked inside to get out of the rain and saw an offering table in there, so I put the Cornbread Buns I'd brought with me on it.

dialogues.speaker: Xiangling
dialogues.text: Then I ended up falling asleep, and when I woke up, I found out that Guoba had eaten every last one. Guoba's followed me around ever since — we're practically family now.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hold up! Stop the conversation, look! The, the stone...!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It burst open!?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Is that... Guoba?

dialogues.speaker: Xiangling
dialogues.text: Guoba!? What are you... what!?

dialogues.speaker: Madame Ping
dialogues.text: Ah, I see the Chili-Mince Cornbread Buns have been served.

dialogues.speaker: Xiangling
dialogues.text: Master!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Granny! Look, the, the Stove God statue looks just like Guoba!

dialogues.speaker: Madame Ping
dialogues.text: Hehe, indeed it does. After all, Guoba is the deity you've been searching for: God of the Stove.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Guoba... Guoba is a GOD!?

dialogues.speaker: Madame Ping
dialogues.text: You asked me if a sufficiently festive atmosphere would be enough to reawaken the Stove God. And my answer is this: Yes and no.

dialogues.speaker: Madame Ping
dialogues.text: The Stove God has always been a deity with great affection for the people, and who acts in response to their desires. To him, the heart's passions and the heart's desires are not the same thing.

dialogues.speaker: Madame Ping
dialogues.text: Passion can be a technique, a skill, something derived from experience. But desires... they are deeper, more innate. They are the heart's strength in its purest form.

dialogues.speaker: Madame Ping
dialogues.text: Masterful Chefs is wonderfully exciting, but it is more an exercise of passion than of desire. And passion alone will not suffice to reawaken the Stove God from his deep slumber.

dialogues.speaker: Madame Ping
dialogues.text: But just now, when Keqing ate this dish she had longed for, a deeply held desire was fulfilled. As well as receiving an answer to her question, she also gained something much more precious: a moment of poignant nostalgia, so vivid it felt like she was right there alongside her grandfather.

dialogues.speaker: Madame Ping
dialogues.text: The enormous power unleashed by the fulfillment of this desire resonated with the Stove God's statue, and caused it to manifest once more the form it took in the past.

dialogues.speaker: Madame Ping
dialogues.text: Of course, the Stove God himself is not contained within the statue. Hehe, the true Stove God has been here with us all along.

dialogues.speaker: Madame Ping
dialogues.text: How does it feel, seeing a statue of yourself from your glory days? Look at him, still so majestic.

dialogues.speaker: Xiangling
dialogues.text: Glory days? Wait... what happened? Did Guoba used to be different from now?

dialogues.speaker: Madame Ping
dialogues.text: Oh, yes. Back in his day, your Guoba was once the Patron God of the Soil.

dialogues.speaker: Madame Ping
dialogues.text: But all the wisdom and power he had then, he has since surrendered to the soil itself.

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: A god surrendering their power to the soil... I have heard this turn of phrase before. But what does it mean?

dialogues.speaker: Madame Ping
dialogues.text: The kinds of trials and tribulations that a land can face are far more than you could imagine. Droughts, floods, torrential rain, hurricanes... earthquakes, tsunamis, fires, and plagues.

dialogues.speaker: Madame Ping
dialogues.text: The threat of disaster will never fully disappear from Liyue. Even woes that have never been faced before in history will come to pass in the future. Such things affect you mortals far more than we adepti, with our immortal forms.

dialogues.speaker: Madame Ping
dialogues.text: He once walked with you over the barren plains until you arrived at last at the harbor. He joined you in building your dwellings and lighting the stoves...

dialogues.speaker: Madame Ping
dialogues.text: It was his hand that lit the very first street lamp of Liyue, and brought the aroma of cooked food into every household in the land.

dialogues.speaker: Madame Ping
dialogues.text: You mortals no longer remember him. But back in the age when you did, he was the closest of all the adepti to the common folk.

dialogues.speaker: Madame Ping
dialogues.text: You once told me that dining is the profoundest of customs in the human world. "To eat well is to consume vitality itself, and to drink well is to partake of the very essence of the world"...

dialogues.speaker: Madame Ping
dialogues.text: It is a matter of paramount importance, you said, for people cannot face the arduous journey ahead on an empty stomach. At once a humble affair and a profound one.

dialogues.speaker: Madame Ping
dialogues.text: A humble meal of maize and spring water is also profound in that, by ensuring one's survival, it paves the way for millennia of human history and culture to come.

dialogues.speaker: Madame Ping
dialogues.text: My dear friend, Liyue has changed so much while you have slept. Looking at the prosperity and beauty around us today... does it make you happy?

dialogues.speaker: Xiangling
dialogues.text: Guoba... this is kind of a huge deal, why didn't you say anything...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: He is not who he once was. Even the power of speech evades him now. There is no way he could have told you...

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: Ohh...

dialogues.speaker: Xiangling
dialogues.text: Guoba... but, but... *sigh*

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: Xiangling...

dialogues.speaker: Madame Ping
dialogues.text: Do not be saddened, Xiangling. There are two sides to everything. Guoba may have lost many of his former faculties, but he is now as carefree as can be, without a single worry in the whole world.

dialogues.speaker: Madame Ping
dialogues.text: In this world we inhabit... who can truly be said to live a life free of all woes? Those with a mind and with knowledge will certainly be troubled by all manner of things.

dialogues.speaker: Madame Ping
dialogues.text: But he has gone further than us in his journey. He had both wisdom and courage. Everything he took upon himself, he was also ready to part with. His carefree demeanor today is a testament to the fact that he is at rest.

dialogues.speaker: Madame Ping
dialogues.text: So since you are his friend, take good care of him. Go out to walk and to play. Allow him to eat, drink, and be merry.

dialogues.speaker: Xiangling
dialogues.text: I will! You can count on me...

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: Xiangling, you have an adeptal affinity. Guoba follows you around because he has respect for you.

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: The moment he awoke, he was met with a familiar flavor in the Chili-Mince Cornbread Buns he ate...

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: After all that time, he still recognized the dish he had invented, and he approved of you as the one who had cooked it.

dialogues.speaker: Madame Ping
dialogues.text: That's right. The taste of one's home cuisine always brings back memories of home. Though he remembered nothing, eating the food you had cooked gave him a feeling of familiarity. That is why he stuck by you.

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: You may be the first person in history to give the Stove God the experience of being a satisfied customer... That makes you quite a remarkable chef.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I love Xiangling's cooking too!

dialogues.speaker: Xiangling
dialogues.text: If that's true, I couldn't be happier. Because... putting a smile on customers' faces is what we chefs are called to do.

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: Well then... It's getting late, and I still have things to do. Time for me to say goodbye.

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: Traveler, Paimon, Xiangling, thank you all very much. I look forward to spending more time together in the future.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Sounds good, we'll be waiting!

dialogues.speaker: Xiangling
dialogues.text: I guess my dad's probably heard the good news already, but I should still go catch up with him. Master, it's been a while since you came by, why don't you join me?

dialogues.speaker: Xiangling
dialogues.text: He thinks about you all the time, you know. He's always telling me to invite you over.

dialogues.speaker: Madame Ping
dialogues.text: Oh, goodness me. Then, far be it from me to refuse.

dialogues.speaker: Madame Ping
dialogues.text: Off we go, then. Let's saunter over gently, and see how all the city folk are getting along.

talks.objective: Talk to the people in front of Wanmin Restaurant

dialogues.speaker: Xiangling
dialogues.text: Hi dad! I'm back! Hey, hey, what are you doing there, I should be the one handling that...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh no! Guoba's taken off!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Look who it is...

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: ...Oh, it's you.

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: Hello there, old friend.

dialogues.speaker: Madame Ping
dialogues.text: Well bless my soul. Are you out for a stroll as well?

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: Given the season, it felt fitting to take a leisurely walk while the meal is being prepared.

dialogues.speaker: Madame Ping
dialogues.text: Quite right, and it also gave us the chance to run into you. Guoba may not recognize you, but as ever, he seems quite delighted to see you.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So... Guoba doesn't remember anything, but can still feel when something is familiar?

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: Friendship will always withstand the ravages of time.

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: Traveler, what do you think of the name of this festival, "Moonchase"?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Evocative and seasonal.

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: The moon is a carrier of countless emotions... So many things only seem to surface as we gaze up beneath its poignant glow. Wherever the moonlight shines, the heart is wont to follow.

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: Fond memories of those no longer with us. Debts of gratitude to old friends. The meaning of ages past and gone. All wrapped up in the city that has existed for so many moons to date.

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: All these things and more... they are why people chase the moon.

dialogues.speaker: Madame Ping
dialogues.text: Hehe, in old age, the sight of many things puts one in a wistful mood. But children are always a beautiful sight to see.

dialogues.speaker: Madame Ping
dialogues.text: Such exuberant life force. It seems to well up from deep within the land itself... a land that has been in existence for so many millennia, and yet one that still dazzles today.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Perhaps that is what defines Liyue.

dialogues.speaker: Madame Ping
dialogues.text: Traveler, this Moonchase Festival has been all the more entertaining with you here to witness it.

dialogues.speaker: Madame Ping
dialogues.text: Now, let's have Xiangling brew us a nice pot of tea. We shall drink and chat at our leisure.

dialogues.speaker: Uncle Tian
dialogues.text: Hehe, what an exciting competition this is.

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: In the interest of keeping everything fair and above-board, please refrain from talking with the host while the competition is in progress.

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: Will we ever manage to reawaken the statue?

dialogues.speaker: Xiangling
dialogues.text: Hmm, everyone's here to eat, what should I cook? Lemme think... I've got some Fowl and some Fish... and Shrimp Meat, so I can do two snack dishes... yes, and a few stir-fries!

dialogues.speaker: Xiangling
dialogues.text: Hee-hee, everyone's gonna love it.

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: The food at Wanmin Restaurant is excellent. I eat here often.

dialogues.speaker: Madame Ping
dialogues.text: You can say that again... Xiangling is a remarkable child, surely the culinary talent of the century.

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: Indeed. To have mastered the craft at her age lends credence to the old aphorism that heroes are made young.

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: Uhh... I—I... *sigh* What am I going to do...

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: I look forward to both of your dishes.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Sure hope Xiangling's preparation is going smoothly. Why don't we go and see how she's getting along?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Great, that's all the recipes. As long as we've got the ingredients, we can make them whenever we want! And if they turn out good, maybe we can have our own cook-off with Xiangling some time!

dialogues.speaker: Xiangling
dialogues.text: Light it up, light it up! First things first, get the stove on!

dialogues.speaker: Xiangling
dialogues.text: Triple-Layered Consommé is pretty bland to begin with. I can't have two sides with the same texture... luckily the organizers have provided some very aromatic broth, it's just a little too gentle... Okay, this is where Beidou was right — a pinch of salt should do the trick!

dialogues.speaker: Xiangling
dialogues.text: Jueyun Chili Chicken is the main event. Can't afford to compromise too much here, but maybe some Pepper will set it apart without alienating anybody.

dialogues.speaker: Xiangling
dialogues.text: Huh? Oh, Yanxiao... he doesn't look so good...

dialogues.speaker: Xiangling
dialogues.text: Ah! Guoba!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It's done! So this is what the dish from the recipe looks like. Let's go give it to Keqing!

dialogues.speaker: Xiangling
dialogues.text: Mine's ready too. Let's go together.
